title: Xdrip+, Dexcom G6, Android Pie (9.0) Successful Connection Settings
symptom: Users report issues with xDrip+ connection to Dexcom G6 on Android Pie devices, including signal loss and inaccurate readings. Native mode does not work, and OB1 collector causes frequent signal loss.
cause: Native mode G6 only works if fallback to xDrip is on, but it auto-enables itself and turns off fallback, making it moot. Also, the Automatic Calibration setting in Advanced Calibration can cause readings to drift 20-30 mg/dL off.
fix: Use OB1 collector off, enable fallback to xDrip, and turn off Automatic Calibration in Less common settings/Advanced Calibration. Also turn on Bypass Quality Check. Calibrate with a glucometer at least once.
evidence_quote: One setting that messes everything up I just realized is: Less common settings/Advanced Calibration/Automatic Calibration. This must be turned off.
